title: Rito ra ku Defiance
intro: Khale loko munhu wo sungula a nga si famba emisaveni, xivumbiwa xa matimba lamakulu a xi yime exivandleni xa ku rhula loku hetisekeke, xi rhendzeriwe hi mimoya-xiviri leyi tinyiketeleke swinene. Loko ku nyikiwa xileriso xin’we, rito rin’wana ni rin’wana a ri nkhinsama hi ku titsongahata—kambe rito rin’we a ri tlakuka hi ku kaneta, naswona ku kaneta koloko a ku ta twala eka nguva yin’wana ni yin’wana ku fikela hi Siku ro hetelela. I mani xivumbiwa lexi lexi weke?
clues: Ndzi vumbiwile hi nchumu lowu pfurhaka swinene, kasi van’wana etlhelo ka mina va vumbiwile hi leswi a va famba ehenhla ka swona.
Ndzi tshame endhawini yo kwetsima exikarhi ka swivumbiwa leswi tinyiketeleke, ku kondza xileriso xin’we xi hundzula hinkwaswo swi hundzuka.
Loko xileriso xi fika, moya-xiviri wun'wana ni wun'wana wu nkhinsamile handle ka mina; ku ala ka mina ku velekiwe hi ku tikukumuxa.
Ndzi hlongoriwile endhawini yoleyo yo kwetsima, ndzi funghiwe hi ndzhukano lowu nga ta tshama hilaha ku nga heriki.
Ndzi kombele nkarhi ku fikela hi Siku ra ku Pfuka, kutani wu nyikiwile. Ndzi hlambanyile leswaku ndzi ta tshinelela moya-xiviri wun’wana ni wun’wana ndzi wu hambukisa.
Loko mhalamhala yi twala, lava va ndzi landzeleleke va ta avelana vuyelo bya mina, va ndzi joyina endzilweni lowu pfurhaka laha ku nga riki na mupfuni loyi a nga va ponisaka.

Namrud
Abu Lahab hi yena

trial.label: Nkarhi Lowu Hlamuselaka
options: Ku ala ku nkhinsama emahlweni ka Adamu
Ku tekela vukwembu ehenhla ka mfumo lowukulu
Ku hlela ku hoxa lowo lulama emalangavini
Ku rhangela vanhu leswaku va gandzela xifaniso xa nsuku
Ku nwela vuthu lerikulu elwandle
trial.answer: Ku ala ku nkhinsama emahlweni ka Adamu

location.label: Ndhawu yo Kwetsima
options: Jannah (Paradeyisi) .
Xigodlho xo hlamarisa lexi nga eNambyeni wa Nayili
Xihondzo xa switina lexi fikaka xi kongoma exibakabakeni
Rhole ra nsuku leri endliweke hi swilo swo khavisa
Xikhegelo xa ndzilo lowu pfurhaka

outcome.label: Vumundzuku Bya Makumu
options: Hlongola, hi ku wisa ku fikela Siku leri tshembisiweke
Ku nwela hi mavuthu ehansi ka magandlati
Ku pfotlosiwa hi maribye lama tshoviweke ku suka exibakabakeni
Yi handzuriwile hi mintlawa ya swinyenyana leswi hahaka
Ku dyiwa hi ku buluka kun’we lokukulu
outcome.answer: Hlongola, hi ku wisa ku fikela Siku leri tshembisiweke

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
